title: Add `--quiet` option to `podman artifact list`
body:
### Feature request description

Our other listing commands mostly include a `--quiet` option to print just the IDs of what is being listed, but this is missing from `podman artifact list`.

### Suggest potential solution

The `artifact list` has a new option, `--quiet`, that (when passed) prints only the truncated digest of all artifacts.

### Have you considered any alternatives?

N/A

### Additional context

N/A

comments.body:
@mheon I think this is not an issue as currently, `podman artifact list` command already does support whats mentioned in this issue. PTAL
```
pawan@Pinjarkars-MacBook-Air podman % podman artifact ls -h
List OCI artifacts

Description:
  List OCI artifacts in local store

Usage:
  podman artifact ls [options]

Aliases:
  ls, list

Examples:
  podman artifact ls

Options:
      --format string            Format volume output using JSON or a Go template (default "{{range .}}{{.Repository}}\t{{.Tag}}\t{{.Digest}}\t{{.Created}}\t{{.Size}}\n{{end -}}")
      --no-trunc[=true|false]    Do not truncate output
  -n, --noheading[=true|false]   Do not print column headings
  -q, --quiet[=true|false]       Display only artifact digests

pawan@Pinjarkars-MacBook-Air podman % podman artifact ls --quiet=true
```
